{"metadata":{"description":"Home Assistant control for DeepSeek Harness agents — approval-gated lights, switches, climate. 给 DeepSeek Harness agent 的 Home Assistant 控制插件，一键接入智能家居，一键接入智能生活。","id":"gh:1333976874","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-smarthome","slug":"YLifeOnlyOnce/dsh-smarthome","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","home-assistant"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Home Assistant control for DeepSeek Harness agents — approval-gated lights, switches, climate. 给 Dee"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"pSeek Harness agent 的 Home Assistant 控制插件，一键接入智能家居，一键接入智能生活。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"Home Assistant control for DeepSeek Harness agents."},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Read entity states · query history · call services — every state-changing call sits behind a human a"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"tates · query history · call services — every state-changing call sits behind a human approval gate."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文 ·"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Zero runtime dependencies beyond the harness itself. Uses Home Assistant's built-in REST API — no MQ"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"TT, no WebSocket, no extra daemon."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## ✨ What it looks like"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Click any image to open the live demo — `docs/demo.html` simulates the full DSH conversation, and it"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"s live console talks to the bundled HA emulator (no real Home Assistant needed)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| ① Ask | ② Approval gate | ③ Done — state changed |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| The agent lists your lights with `ha_list_entities`. | `ha_call_service` pauses for a human approv"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"al dialog. | Approved — `ha_get_state` confirms the light turned on. |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**And the Web UI dashboard card** — call `ha_dashboard` and get a live snapshot of the whole home re"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ndered right in the conversation:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**The Home Assistant it plugs into** — a typical smart-home dashboard like this one (illustration):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 🎯 What can it do?"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Talk to your home the way you talk to an assistant — every write goes through a human approval gate "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"o your home the way you talk to an assistant — every write goes through a human approval gate first."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| You say | What happens |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| "Check the whole house — which devices are still on?" | Agent scans with `ha_list_entities` / `ha_"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"get_state` and summarizes |
| "Show me the home dashboard." | `ha_dashboard` renders a **live dashbo"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ard card** in the conversation — devices, scenes and recent changes at a glance |
| "Wait until the "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"washer finishes, then tell me on my phone." | `ha_wait_for_state` polls to completion → `ha_notify` "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"pushes to HA |
| "What's the weather tomorrow — should I take an umbrella?" | `ha_weather` returns a"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" structured forecast |
| "Set the bedroom light to 200 brightness." | `ha_call_service` → **approval"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" dialog** → executes → state updates instantly |
| "Turn off every light in the living room." | **Ar"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"ea targeting** — one call controls the whole room |
| "Start cinema mode." | Scene activation: dimme"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"d lights + TV on — a whole cascade of devices in one shot (`ha_events` shows each change live) |
| ""},{"id":"p15s10","text":"What changed in the house in the last hour?" | Real-time `state_changed` events from the **WebSocket"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"** feed |
| "Is the living room warm enough? Compare with the bedroom." | `ha_get_state` / `ha_rende"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"r_template` over sensors |
| "Turn everything off, I'm leaving." | One scene (`scene.away`) or a mul"},{"id":"p15s13","text":"ti-entity service call |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 💡 Why it's good — how useful is it?"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **One-line install**: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-smarthome`, then just talk to the agent.
-"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" **Safe by default**: every state-changing call stops for human approval; `allowedDomains` is a seco"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"nd deny-list belt. The agent can never touch your home without you saying yes.
- **Natural language "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"control**: no apps to fiddle with, no API docs to memorize — "dim the lights" just works.
- **Always"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" current**: state changes reach the agent in real time over WebSocket, so it never "thinks" the ligh"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"t is still on when you switched it off.
- **Lightweight**: zero runtime dependencies — plain REST + "},{"id":"p17s7","text":"Node's built-in WebSocket. No MQTT broker, no extra daemon.
- **Try it without Home Assistant**: the"},{"id":"p17s8","text":" repo ships a demo emulator + interactive demo page — 5 minutes to a full feel of the plugin.
- **En"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"gineered, not hacked together**: 36 tests including a full **real agent-loop end-to-end** suite, str"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"d together**: 36 tests including a full **real agent-loop end-to-end** suite, strict TypeScript, CI."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## 🛠 Features"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Tool | Description | Approval |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `ha_health` | Verify the connection; return instance name, version, timezone, WebSocket status | r"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ead |
| `ha_list_entities` | List entities, filter by domain (`light`, `switch`, `sensor`…) and text"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" | read |
| `ha_list_areas` | List rooms (areas) via the WebSocket API, e.g. `living_room` | read |
"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"| `ha_list_devices` | List physical devices via the WebSocket device registry | read |
| `ha_get_sta"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"te` | Full state + attributes of one entity | read |
| `ha_history` | State-change timeline over a t"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"ime window | read |
| `ha_events` | Recent real-time state changes buffered from the WebSocket | rea"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"d |
| `ha_list_scenes` | List one-click scenes (`cinema`, `goodnight`, `away`…) | read |
| `ha_dashb"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"oard` | Full home snapshot rendered as a **dashboard card** in the Web UI | read |
| `ha_wait_for_st"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"ate` | Poll until an entity matches / stops matching a state (washer done, temperature reached…) | r"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"ead |
| `ha_notify` | Send a notification via Home Assistant (persistent / phone / speaker) | no gat"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"e |
| `ha_weather` | Current weather + structured forecast from the weather entity | read |
| `ha_ca"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"ll_service` | Call any service — by **entity**, by **area** (whole room), by **device**, or **scene*"},{"id":"p20s13","text":"* | **ask** |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 🔒 Security"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- A Home Assistant token can control **everything** in your instance — there is no per-entity scope."},{"id":"p22s2","text":" That is why `requireApproval` defaults to `true` and `ha_call_service` / `ha_render_template` alway"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"s route through the harness approval seam.
- `allowedDomains` is a second belt: when set, service ca"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"lls on other domains are denied outright.
- Prefer `tokenEnv` over `token` so the secret never lands"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" in a committed config file."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## 📋 Compatibility"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Real Home Assistant compatibility"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Uses the **v1 REST API** (`/api/states`, `/api/services/…`, `/api/history/…`, `/api/template`, `/a"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"pi/config`) and the **WebSocket API** (`/api/websocket`: auth, `subscribe_events`, `config/area_regi"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"stry/list`, `config/device_registry/list`) — the same protocols the official HA frontend speaks.
- R"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"equires a **long-lived access token** (Profile → Security → Long-lived access tokens).
- Caveats: se"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"lf-signed HTTPS certificates are not supported (use `http://` or a valid cert); a restricted token t"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"hat cannot call services will fail `ha_call_service`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and changes fast. This plugin is verified against the publi"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"shed `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7` line; if a harness update breaks it, please open an issue."}],"truncated":true}
